_about: API list prices in US dollars per million tokens, used to show what subscription usage would cost on a pay-per-token API key. Edit freely; the server reloads this file on change. Models match by longest id prefix, so 'claude-opus-5-5' covers 'claude-opus-5-5[1m]'. cache_write_1h defaults to 2x input and cache_write to 1.25x input when omitted.

sources.openai: developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (official, Standard tier), checked 2026-10-28; requests over 272K input tokens cost more
sources.google: ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (official, paid tier), checked 2026-10-28; introductory prices double on the dates noted

claude-opus-5-5.note: Cache write $5 (5 min). Fast mode is 2x

gpt-6-astra.note: Over 272K input tokens: $20 in, $2 cached, $75 out

gpt-6.1-sol.note: Over 272K input tokens: $4 in, $0.20 cached, $15 out

gemini-4-argon.note: Introductory price; $4 in, $0.20 cached, $20 out from 2026-12-01

gemini-3.8-flash.note: Introductory price; $1.50 in, $0.15 cached, $7.50 out from 2027-01-01. Cache storage $0.50 per 1M tokens per hour

Claude Max 20x.note: main Claude account; limits are shared with every device on it

ChatGPT Pro.note: plan_type pro, as reported by Codex

Google (Antigravity).note: Google AI Ultra, as Antigravity reports the tier. Ultra has $99.99 and $199.99 US tiers since May 2026; Antigravity offers an upgrade to a higher Ultra plan, so this assumes $99.99. Edit if your bill differs.
